primary_policy: First recorded terminal attempt per arm/question; retries never replace primary failures or usage.

input_guard.source: Anchored Input tokens exceeded: <prompt_estimate> > <cap> error, allowing only known controller/role wrappers; optional explicit input_guard fields.

provenance.validation: Frozen question IDs, manifest hashes, model, split, budgets, condition/repeat, and recorded code fingerprint checked.

csv_policy: Only first-attempt terminal errors or budget stops; eight allow-listed columns; no clinical content or error bodies.
